text: Prefer pipeline() to parallel(). pipeline() runs each item through every stage independently with no barrier, so wall-clock equals the slowest single chain. parallel() is a BARRIER that waits for all thunks, and is only correct when a stage genuinely needs cross-item context from all of the previous stage. A thunk that throws resolves to null rather than rejecting, so filter(Boolean) before use.
